Title: One drawer, three piles, finished before the next
Description: Start with one drawer, sort it into three piles, and finish it. Plus where the stuck items go: batteries, old pills, phones, sunscreen, and tax papers.

Title: Heat pump? Keep setbacks to about 3.6°F (2°C)
Description: Setbacks, not a magic number, do the saving: 7–10°F for 8 hours with a furnace, about 3.6°F with a heat pump, a 55°F winter floor, and the dollar math.
Keywords: heating and cooling costs, water and gas bills, heating and HVAC

Title: Cloudy glasses? A vinegar rub tells film from etching
Description: Dirty dishes after a cycle? Spin the spray arm, clean the filter, run the tap hot. A symptom table, the vinegar test for cloudy glass, and water hardness math.

Title: Deep gap? Backer rod first, caulk half as deep as wide
Description: Caulk peels when the label doesn't fit the joint. Compare silicone, siliconized acrylic and painter's caulk, size deep gaps with backer rod, and time the cure.

Title: Skip antibacterial hand soap; plain soap works as well
Description: One caddy covers routine cleaning. Add one disinfectant for when germs matter, and learn the contact times (4 minutes for wipes) that make it work. Plus 10 skips.
